We will review your files and description, then send your quote${SB.phone.trim()?' to '+esc(SB.phone):SB.email.trim()?' to '+esc(SB.email):''}.</p><ol class="stp" style="justify-content:center"><li class="on">Request received</li><li>We review</li><li>You get a quote</li><li>Approve, pay, track</li></ol><a class="btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${wa(qMsg(quotes[0]))}">Send this request on WhatsApp</a> <a class="btn ghost" href="#track">See my requests</a> <button class="btn ghost" onclick="SB.done='';SB.files=[];SB.desc='';view()">Submit another</button><p style="margin-top:16px"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${wa('Hi Kazisafi, I just sent request '+SB.done+'.')}">Want a faster answer? Message our designers on WhatsApp</a></p></div>`}
function quoteFields(){const it=IT[SB.i],mine=['f','b'].some(s=>S.D[s].length)&&S.i==SB.i;
return`<div class="panel"><h3>Upload your design, mockup or logo</h3><label class="drop" ondragover="event.preventDefault();this.classList.add('over')" ondragleave="this.classList.remove('over')" ondrop="dp(event)"><input type="file" multiple hidden accept="image/*,.pdf,.ai,.eps,.svg,.psd,.cdr" onchange="fu(this.files)"><b>Drop files here or tap to choose</b><small>PNG, JPG, PDF, AI, EPS, SVG or PSD. Up to 10 MB each.</small></label>${SB.files.length||mine?`<div class="fl">${mine?`<div><div class="ph">${svg(S)}</div>Online design</div>`:''}${SB.files.map((f,i)=>`<div>${f.p?`<img src="${f.p}" alt="">`:'<div class="ph">File</div>'}<button aria-label="Remove file" onclick="fx(${i})">×</button>${esc(f.n.slice(0,16))}<br>${f.sz||''}</div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}</div>

<div class="panel"><h3>Your details</h3><label class="fld">Full name<input value="${esc(SB.name)}" oninput="SB.name=this.value"></label><div class="two2"><label class="fld">Phone<input type="tel" value="${esc(SB.phone)}" placeholder="07XX XXX XXX" oninput="SB.phone=this.value"></label><label class="fld">Email<input type="email" value="${esc(SB.email)}" oninput="SB.email=this.value"></label></div></div>`}
function qtyUI(){const it=IT[S.i],q=qtyOf(S),th=it.m>1?it.m*5:10;
if(S.z)return`<div class="qp">${[10,25,50,100].map(n=>`<button class="chip" onclick="qsplit(${n})">${n} pieces${dc(n,1)<1?', save '+Math.round((1-dc(n,1))*100)+'%':''}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="sizes">${['S','M','L','XL','XXL'].map(z=>`<div><b>${z}</b><span class="step"><button aria-label="Less ${z}" onclick="zs('${z}',-1)">−</button><span>${S.sz[z]}</span><button aria-label="More ${z}" onclick="zs('${z}',1)">+</button></span></div>`).join('')}</div><small style="margin-top:8px">${q} pieces in total. Tap a quick amount to split it across sizes, or set each size yourself.</small><details><summary>Size guide</summary><table class="tbl"><tr><td>S</td><td>Chest 96 cm</td></tr><tr><td>M</td><td>Chest 101 cm</td></tr><tr><td>L</td><td>Chest 106 cm</td></tr><tr><td>XL</td><td>Chest 111 cm</td></tr><tr><td>XXL</td><td>Chest 116 cm</td></tr></table></details><label class="fld">Names and numbers (optional)<textarea rows="3" placeholder="One per line, for example: Brian, 10, L" oninput="S.team=this.value">${esc(S.team||'')}</textarea></label>`;
return`<div class="qp">${(it.m>1?[1,2.5,5,10].map(x=>x*it.m):[10,25,50,100]).map(n=>`<button class="chip${q==n?' on':''}" onclick="qset(${n})">${n}${dc(n,it.m)<1?', save '+Math.round((1-dc(n,it.m))*100)+'%':''}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="step"><button aria-label="Less" onclick="sq(-1)">−</button><input type="number" class="qn" aria-label="Quantity" min="${S.m}" value="${S.qty}" oninput="S.qty=Math.max(S.m,+this.value||S.m);psum()" onchange="view()"><button aria-label="More" onclick="sq(1)">+</button></div><small style="margin-top:8px">${it.m>1?'Minimum '+it.m+'. ':''}Order ${th} or more to save 10%.</small>`}
function colUI(){const ops=OPS[SH[S.k].o]||[];return(S.nc?'<p class="hint">This item is printed on standard white stock.</p>':`<div class="swg">${PAL.map(([n,c])=>`<button class="${c==S.color?'on':''}" onclick="S.color='${c}';view()" aria-label="${n}"><i style="background:${c}"></i>${n}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="chips" style="margin-top:10px;align-items:center"><span class="hint">Another colour?</span><input type="color" class="cpk" value="${/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(S.color)?S.color:'#ffffff'}" onchange="S.color=this.value;view()" aria-label="Custom colour"><b>${CN(S.color)}</b></div>`)+ops.map((g,gi)=>`<h3>${g[0]}</h3><div class="chips">${g[1].map((x,xi)=>`<button class="chip${(S.o[gi]||0)==xi?' on':''}" onclick="so(${gi},${xi})">${x[0]}${x[1]?', +'+x[1]:''}</button>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')}
function designUI(){const mine=['f','b'].some(s=>S.D[s].length),mys=saved.map((x,i)=>[x,i]).filter(([x])=>x.k==S.k);
return`${mine?`<div class="alt" style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center"><div class="th">${svg(S)}</div><div style="flex:1"><b>Your design is ready</b><small>Add it to your cart, or keep editing.</small></div><button class="btn ghost" style="padding:6px 14px" onclick="ed()">Edit</button></div>`:''}
<div class="how"><div class="hc${SB.how=='upload'?' on':''}"><h4>Submit a design or logo</h4><p>Upload your file and tell us what you need.</p><button class="btn ghost" onclick="how('upload')">Upload design</button></div><div class="hc"><h4>Get help from our designers</h4><p>Chat with us on WhatsApp right now. ${SB.how=='upload'?`<div class="col" style="margin-top:14px">${quoteFields()}<button class="btn full" onclick="sbm()">Get my quote</button></div>`:''}
${mys.length?`<h3>My saved designs</h3><div class="mine">${mys.map(([x,i])=>`<button class="th" aria-label="Open saved design" onclick="opn(${i});go('#product')">${svg(x)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`:''}
<label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" ${S.later?'checked':''} onchange="S.later=this.checked?1:0;view()"> I will send my design later on WhatsApp</label>`}
function psumHTML(){const q=qtyOf(S),d=dc(q,S.m),th=S.m>1?S.m*5:10,nx=q<th?[th,10]:q<th*2.5?[Math.round(th*2.5),15]:q<th*5?[th*5,20]:null;
return`<h3 style="margin-top:0">Your order</h3><div class="sum"><span>${q} × ${esc(S.n)}</span><b>${K(lt$(S))}</b></div><div class="sum"><span>Price each</span><span>${K(unitP(S))}</span></div>${d<1?`<div class="sum"><span>Bulk saving</span><span>${Math.round((1-d)*100)}% off</span></div>`:''}${nx?`<small style="color:var(--red)">Add ${nx[0]-q} more to save ${nx[1]}%.</small>`:''}<div class="alt">Ready by about <b>${eta(CO.ta,CO.d)}</b> with ${TA[CO.ta][0].toLowerCase()} and ${DL[CO.d][0].toLowerCase()}.</div><div class="chips" style="margin-bottom:8px">${TA.map((x,i)=>`<button class="chip${i==CO.ta?' on':''}" onclick="CO.ta=${i};psum()">${x[0].split(',')[0]}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn full" onclick="padd()">Add to cart</button><button class="btn ghost full" onclick="pquote()">Get a quote</button><a class="btn ghost full" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${wa(waMsg('I have a question about this product.'))}">Ask us on WhatsApp</a><a class="btn ghost full" href="tel:+254743288927">Call 0743 288 927</a>`}

function qset(n){S.qty=n;view()}
function qsplit(n){const w=[.1,.25,.3,.25,.1],k=['S','M','L','XL','XXL'],o=[2,1,3,0,4];let r=w.map(x=>Math.floor(n*x)),d=n-r.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);for(let i=0;d>0;i++,d--)r[o[i%5]]++;k.forEach((z,i)=>S.sz[z]=r[i]);view()}
function how(k){SB.how=SB.how==k?'':k;view()}
function pquote(){SB.how='upload';view();setTimeout(()=>{const e=$('#st3');if(e)e.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})},60)}
function padd(){const has=['f','b'].some(s=>S.D[s].length)||SB.files.length||S.later;if(!has)return toast('Step 3: upload a design, chat with our designers or design here. You can also tick send my design later.');if(!qtyOf(S))return toast('Choose how many pieces you need.');const c=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S));c.files=SB.files.map(f=>f.n);bag.push(c);sv();$('#badge').textContent=cnt();fc();toast('Added to cart');view()}
function infoBlock(){const it=IT[S.i],gi=it.g,th=it.m>1?it.m*5:10,tiers=[[1,'1 piece'+(it.m>1?' or more':''),0],[th,th+' or more',10],[Math.round(th*2.5),Math.round(th*2.5)+' or more',15],[th*5,th*5+' or more',20]],rel=REL[gi].map(g=>IT.findIndex(x=>x.g==g)).filter(i=>i>=0);
return`<div class="cols2" style="margin-top:30px"><div><h2 style="margin-top:0">About this product</h2><table class="tbl"><tr><th>Materials</th><td>${GINFO[gi][1]}</td></tr><tr><th>Print area</th><td>${GINFO[gi][2]}</td></tr><tr><th>Minimum order</th><td>${it.m>1?it.m+' pieces':'1 piece'}</td></tr><tr><th>Starting price</th><td>${K(it.b)} each</td></tr></table><h2>Bulk prices</h2><table class="tbl"><tr><th>Quantity</th><th>Price each</th><th>You save</th></tr>${tiers.map(([q,l,d])=>`<tr><td>${l}</td><td>${K(Math.round(it.b*(100-d)/100))}</td><td>${d?d+'%':'-'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table></div>
<div><h2 style="margin-top:0">Artwork guide</h2><ul><li>Use PNG, JPG, PDF, AI, EPS or SVG files.</li><li>Send images at 300 dpi at the final size.</li><li>Add 3 mm bleed and keep text 5 mm inside the edge.</li><li>Convert fonts to outlines in PDF, AI and EPS files.</li><li>Save logos as a transparent PNG or a vector file.</li></ul><h2>Questions</h2>${FAQ.slice(0,4).map(f=>`<details><summary>${f[0]}</summary><p>${f[1]}</p></details>`).join('')}</div></div>${rel.length?`<h2>Frequently bought together</h2><div class="grid">${rel.slice(0,4).map(i=>card(IT[i],i,0)).join('')}</div>`:''}${recentRow()}`}

if(T=='tpl')h=`<h3>Templates</h3><p class="hint">Pick a layout, then change the words, fonts and colours.</p><div class="tp" style="margin-top:10px">${TP.map((x,i)=>`<button onclick="tpl(${i})">${x[0]}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
else if(T=='text')h=`<h3>Add text</h3><div class="tp"><button style="font:900 22px Archivo;font-stretch:125%" onclick="addT('Heading')">Add a heading</button><button style="font:800 17px 'Playfair Display',serif" onclick="addT('Subheading',0,{font:2})">Add a subheading</button><button style="font:400 18px Pacifico,cursive" onclick="addT('Little note',0,{font:3})">Add a little note</button></div><h3>Quick text</h3><div class="chips">${QT.map((x,i)=>`<button class="chip" onclick="addT(QT[${i}],0,{font:6})">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><h3>Fonts</h3><div class="gi">${FN.map((f,i)=>`<button aria-label="${f[2]}" title="${f[2]}" style="font-family:'${f[0]}';font-weight:${f[1]};font-size:20px" onclick="addT('Your text',0,{font:${i}})">Aa</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
else if(T=='img')h=`<h3>Upload</h3><label class="up"><input type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onchange="up(this.files[0])">Upload a logo or photo</label><p class="hint" style="margin-top:8px">A PNG with a transparent background looks sharpest. You can also drop an image onto the canvas.</p>${PICS.length?`<h3>Your uploads</h3><div class="gi">${PICS.map((x,i)=>`<button onclick="addPic(${i})"><img src="${x.src}" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain"></button>`).join('')}</div>`:''}`;
else if(T=='shape')h=`<h3>Shapes</h3><div class="gi">${Object.keys(SHP).map(k=>`<button aria-label="${k}" title="${k}" onclick="addShape('${k}')"><svg viewBox="-56 -56 112 112"><path d="${SHP[k]}" fill="${k=='line'?'none':'currentColor'}" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="${k=='line'?6:0}" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
else if(T=='icon')h=`<h3>Graphics</h3><div class="gi">${Object.keys(IC2).map(k=>`<button aria-label="${k}" title="${k}" onclick="addIcon('${k}')"><svg viewBox="-56 -56 112 112"><path d="${IC2[k]}" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd"/></svg></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
else if(T=='emo')h=`<h3>Emoji</h3><div class="gi">${EM.map(x=>`<button style="font-size:26px" onclick="addT('${x}',0,{font:0,s:90})">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
else if(T=='cv')h=`<h3>Background</h3><div class="chips">${['Cutting mat','White','Light grey','Charcoal','Red','Sky'].map((n,i)=>`<button class="chip${SBG==i?' on':''}" onclick="SBG=${i};draw();fl()">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div><h3>Guides</h3><div class="chips">${[['Print area','GD'],['Safe zone','SAFE'],['Grid','GRD'],['Snap to grid','SNP'],['Size in cm','SZC'],['Ground shadow','SHD']].map(([n,k])=>`<button class="chip${CVO[k]?' on':''}" onclick="cvt('${k}')">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div><h3>Zoom</h3><div class="chips">${[['Fit',1],['150%',1.5],['200%',2]].map(([n,v])=>`<button class="chip${ZM==v?' on':''}" onclick="ZM=${v};tb();draw();fl()">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div><h3>This side</h3><div class="chips">${p.bk?`<button class="chip" onclick="cb()">Copy all to the ${S.side=='f'?'back':'front'}</button>`:''}<button class="chip" onclick="lact('clr')">Clear everything</button><button class="chip" onclick="$('#kbm').classList.add('on')">Keyboard shortcuts</button></div>`;
else h=`<h3>Product</h3><select class="sel" aria-label="Product" onchange="sp(+this.value)">${GR.map((g,gi)=>`<optgroup label="${g}">${IT.map((x,i)=>x.g==gi?`<option value="${i}"${i==S.i?' selected':''}>${x.n}</option>`:'').join('')}</optgroup>`).join('')}</select>${p.bk?'<p class="hint" style="margin-top:6px">Back print adds KES 300 each.</p>':''}
${S.nc?'':`<h3>Colour: ${CN(S.color)}</h3><div class="chips">${PAL.map(([n,c])=>`<button class="sw${c==S.color?' on':''}" style="background:${c}" title="${n}" aria-label="${n}" onclick="S.color='${c}';commit();draw();fl()"></button>`).join('')}<input type="color" class="cpk" value="${/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(S.color)?S.color:'#ffffff'}" oninput="S.color=this.value;draw()" onchange="commit();fl()" aria-label="Custom colour"></div>`}
${ops.map((g,gi)=>`<h3>${g[0]}</h3><div class="chips">${g[1].map((x,xi)=>`<button class="chip${(S.o[gi]||0)==xi?' on':''}" onclick="so(${gi},${xi})">${x[0]}${x[1]?', +'+x[1]:''}</button>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')}
